fusions.name: Bask, Then Lunge
fusions.desc: Lunges up to 5 tiles to the target and clamps down for a bite that deals 13 damage and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Its damage rises 6% for every 10% of health the target still has, up to 60%.

fusions.name: Ford-Keeper's Clamp
fusions.desc: A bite across a cone 3 tiles long that deals 28 damage to everything in it, ignores armour and leaves it [Suppressed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Still as the Bank
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Verdict
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 12 seconds.
